python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')
# Download Android command line tools
print("Downloading Android SDK cmdline-tools...")
# Create SDK directory
c.exec_command("mkdir -p ~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools")
# Download tools (check latest URL)
c.exec_command("""cd ~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools &&
curl -sL -o cmdline-tools.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip &&
unzip -q cmdline-tools.zip &&
rm cmdline-tools.zip &&
mv cmdline-tools latest""")
print("Downloaded!")
# Accept licenses
c.exec_command("yes | ~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses")
print("Licenses accepted!")
# Install SDKs

c.exec_command("~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager 'platforms;android-34' 'build-tools;34.0.0' 'platform-tools' 2>&1 | tail -20")
print("SDK installed!")
c.close()
EOF
